title: Mutual-Taught for Co-adapting Policy and Reward Models
authors_zh: Tianyuan Shi、Canbin Huang、Fanqi Wan、Longguang Zhong、Ziyi Yang、Weizhou Shen、Xiaojun Quan、Ming Yan
paper_type_zh: 动态偏好数据构造与策略—奖励模型协同训练配方
best_for_zh: 研究迭代 DPO、奖励模型分布漂移、伪偏好筛选和闭环奖励风险的读者
one_line: Alternates RM-ranked on-policy DPO with mixed reward-model self-training, using filtered updated-versus-previous policy pairs to refresh the RM without new human labels.
交替用当前 RM 排序的 on-policy 偏好训练策略，再用策略更新前后的响应构造经低质量过滤的混合偏好数据刷新 RM；机制可核验，但官方代码链接当前没有 Mutual-Taught 专用实现。
why: Treats preference records, checkpoint selection, and reward-model refresh as one evolving construction pipeline while exposing a circular-label risk that static preference datasets hide.
inclusion_reason: Defines a dynamic preference-data loop in which a reward model labels on-policy data for DPO and policy changes generate filtered pseudo-preferences for reward-model refresh, making policy-RM distribution shift and circular feedback directly auditable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The authoritative record is the ACL Anthology version published in the Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics, Volume 1: Long Papers, July 2025, pages 16285–16298. The paper and its appendices ask how a learned reward model can remain useful after an optimizing policy moves away from the response distribution on which that reward model was trained. Repeated human reannotation would address the shift but adds cost; keeping the RM fixed leaves a reward-hacking and miscalibration channel. (Paper §1; ACL record)

This work belongs in data_construction_open_release_recipes because its central object is not a new static corpus but a recipe for constructing changing preference views during training. One E-step record consists of an UltraFeedback prompt, five responses from the current policy, current-RM scores, and a length-controlled chosen/rejected pair for DPO. One M-step record consists of a reward-update prompt, a response from the selected updated policy, a response from the preceding policy, their current-RM scores and margin, the iteration-specific standard-deviation threshold, and an accept/discard decision for a pseudo-preference. The main RM update also mixes these policy-comparison records with self-training preferences from the policy update. (Paper §4.2–4.3, §5.1, §5.3; Appendix B–C)

The paper does not solve general preference acquisition, provide new human ground truth, or establish that a learned RM is a sound verifier. It studies synthetic, pairwise feedback for instruction-following policies initialized from Llama-3-8B-Instruct and FsfairX-Llama3-RM-v0.1 on UltraFeedback. The feedback contract is judgment-based: the current scalar RM determines candidate order, checkpoint selection, pseudo-pair filtering, and subsequent training data. That makes the method relevant to preference learning and reward modeling, but not evidence for programmatically verified outcomes, SFT data, or a generally correct reward oracle.

Atlas inclusion is useful because Mutual-Taught makes reward-model refresh part of data lineage: policy changes create new comparisons, and those comparisons change the model that will label the next policy data. The L4 content boundary is the complete ACL paper, appendices, official bibliographic records, and inspection of the GitHub URL printed in the paper. The mechanism and reported tables are traceable, but training reuse is blocked: the official link currently resolves to an Alignment Handbook snapshot rather than a verified Mutual-Taught implementation, and no dynamic pairs, rejected-pair logs, configs, checkpoints, or split manifest were found.

权威入口是 ACL Anthology：论文发表于 2025 年 7 月的第 63 届 Association for Computational Linguistics 年会长文集第一卷，页码 16285–16298。论文及附录研究的问题是：当优化中的策略逐渐偏离奖励模型原来的训练响应分布时，如何让学习式奖励模型继续提供有效反馈。反复获取人类新标注可以应对漂移，但成本较高；固定 RM 则会留下 reward hacking 与校准失效通道。（论文 §1；ACL 官方记录）

该工作属于 data_construction_open_release_recipes，因为它的核心对象不是新的静态语料，而是训练期间持续构造动态偏好视图的配方。一条 E-step 记录包含 UltraFeedback 提示、当前策略生成的五个响应、当前 RM 分数，以及经长度控制后供 DPO 使用的 chosen/rejected pair。一条 M-step 记录包含奖励更新提示、选中更新策略与上一策略各自生成的响应、两者的当前 RM 分数及差值、随迭代变化的标准差阈值，以及伪偏好 pair 的保留或丢弃决策。主要 RM 更新还会把这些策略比较记录与策略更新阶段产生的 self-training 偏好混合。（论文 §4.2–4.3、§5.1、§5.3；附录 B–C）

论文没有解决通用偏好获取，没有提供新的人类真值，也没有证明学习式 RM 是可靠的 verifier。实验只研究由 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 与 FsfairX-Llama3-RM-v0.1 初始化、基于 UltraFeedback 的指令跟随策略与合成 pairwise feedback。反馈契约依赖判断：当前标量 RM 同时决定候选排序、checkpoint 选择、伪 pair 筛选和后续训练数据。因此它适用于 preference learning 与 reward modeling，不应被当作程序可验证结果数据、SFT 数据或普遍正确的奖励 oracle。

将其纳入 Atlas 的价值在于，Mutual-Taught 把 RM 刷新明确纳入数据谱系：策略变化产生新比较，新比较又改变下一轮标注策略数据的 RM。当前 L4 内容边界包括完整 ACL 论文与附录、官方书目信息，以及对论文所印 GitHub 地址的核查。机制和报告表格可追溯，但训练复用仍受阻：官方链接当前指向 Alignment Handbook 快照，而非可验证的 Mutual-Taught 实现；动态 pair、被拒日志、配置、checkpoint 和 split manifest 也均未找到。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Mutual-Taught's contribution is a two-way data loop: the current RM turns on-policy responses into DPO preferences for the policy, then the observed policy change is turned into pseudo-preference data for refreshing the RM. The authors describe the alternation as EM-inspired. The unknown latent object is an optimal human-preference response distribution; the implementation uses an evolving policy as its surrogate and a learned RM as its only operational preference signal. (Paper §4.1–4.2, Figure 2)

In the E-step, the previous policy samples responses and the current RM ranks them. DPO moves the policy relative to the previous checkpoint. Saved checkpoints are evaluated against that preceding policy on a fixed 2,000-prompt set, again using the current RM, and the highest RM-scored win-rate checkpoint is retained. In the M-step, the retained policy and its predecessor each generate a response for the same reward-update prompt. The method provisionally labels the updated response preferred, computes its RM margin over the previous response, and applies Low-Quality Data Filtering before Bradley–Terry reward training. (Paper Eq. 4–8; Appendix B–C)

The feedback system observes text responses and scalar RM scores. It can rank candidates under the current RM, estimate the standard deviation of that RM's scores, and detect when the updated response is strongly worse according to the same RM. It cannot directly observe human preference, factual correctness, safety, task success, or whether a higher score is caused by reward exploitation. It also does not independently validate the pseudo-label direction: the model being refreshed supplies the scores used to select and filter its own future training records.

The direction represented here is policy–reward-model co-adaptation under distribution shift. Iterative DPO, SPPO, and ReST-style methods also generate training data from an evolving policy, but commonly leave an external RM fixed or update only the policy. ReSTEM is also framed through self-training and EM, while Mutual-Taught's stated distinction is the explicit M-step that refreshes a separate RM. Self-Rewarding and Meta-Rewarding instead make the policy model act as an LLM judge and require strong judgment capability; Mutual-Taught retains a separate scalar RM. ReST-MCTS* uses ground-truth-checkable search data, unlike this judgment-only loop. (Paper §2)

The concrete difference is therefore not DPO, Bradley–Terry loss, checkpointing, or pseudo-labeling individually. It is the construction contract that couples them: on-policy RM labels train the policy; updated-versus-previous policy behavior trains the RM; model selection and variance-aware filtering attempt to stabilize both directions. The contract remains circular rather than ground-truth anchored, which is the most important boundary when comparing it with rule-verified or newly human-labeled refresh pipelines.

Mutual-Taught 的贡献是一个双向数据闭环：当前 RM 把 on-policy 响应转成供策略 DPO 使用的偏好，随后策略变化又被转成刷新 RM 的伪偏好数据。作者把这一交替过程称为受 EM 启发。未知的潜变量是符合人类偏好的最优响应分布；实际实现以持续变化的策略作为替代，并把学习式 RM 当作唯一可操作偏好信号。（论文 §4.1–4.2，图 2）

在 E-step 中，上一策略采样响应，当前 RM 负责排序，DPO 以上一 checkpoint 为参照更新策略。保存的 checkpoint 会在固定 2000 条提示上与上一策略比较，判断仍由当前 RM 完成，最后保留 RM 胜率最高的 checkpoint。在 M-step 中，选中策略与其上一版本针对同一奖励更新提示各生成一个响应；方法先把更新策略响应暂定为 preferred，计算其相对上一响应的 RM 分数差，再经过 Low-Quality Data Filtering 后进行 Bradley–Terry 奖励训练。（论文公式 4–8；附录 B–C）

反馈系统能够观察文本响应和标量 RM 分数，可以按当前 RM 排序候选、估计 RM 分数标准差，并识别“按同一 RM 看，更新响应明显更差”的情况。它不能直接观察人类偏好、事实正确性、安全性、任务成功，或更高分是否来自 reward exploitation。伪标签方向也没有独立验证：将被刷新的模型本身提供分数，用来选择并筛选它未来的训练记录。

该工作代表“分布漂移下的策略—奖励模型协同适配”方向。Iterative DPO、SPPO 和 ReST 类方法也会从变化中的策略生成训练数据，但通常保持外部 RM 固定，或只更新策略。ReSTEM 同样采用 self-training 与 EM 叙事，而 Mutual-Taught 声称的区别是增加明确的 M-step 来刷新独立 RM。Self-Rewarding 与 Meta-Rewarding 则让策略模型充当 LLM judge，依赖较强的判断能力；Mutual-Taught 保留独立标量 RM。ReST-MCTS* 使用可由 ground truth 检查的搜索数据，与这里纯判断式闭环不同。（论文 §2）

因此，真正的差别并不在于单独采用 DPO、Bradley–Terry loss、checkpoint 或伪标注，而是把这些组件耦合成一个构造契约：on-policy RM 标签训练策略，更新前后策略行为训练 RM，再由模型选择与方差感知筛选稳定两个方向。该契约仍是循环式而非真值锚定，这是将它与规则验证或新增人类标注的刷新流程比较时最重要的边界。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reported pipeline can be reconstructed at the module level, although the official method implementation is unavailable.

  1. Inputs and partitioning. Initialize the policy from Llama-3-8B-Instruct and the RM from FsfairX-Llama3-RM-v0.1. Start from about 60,000 UltraFeedback prompts. The paper partitions them into two policy-update portions and one RM-update portion; two thirds are used for policy updates and one third is reserved for RM updates. Separately, randomly sample a fixed 2,000-prompt UltraFeedback set D_MS for checkpoint selection. Exact record IDs and disjointness are unknown. (Paper §5.1; Appendix B–C)
  1. E-step candidate generation and pair construction. For each policy-update prompt, sample M=5 responses from the current policy at temperature 0.8 and top-p 0.95. Score all responses with the current RM. For length control, retain responses above the prompt-level average reward, choose the shortest of them as chosen, and use the lowest-scoring response as rejected. Train DPO for one epoch with the preceding policy as reference, beta 0.01, batch size 128, maximum sequence length 2,048, learning rate 7e-7, cosine scheduling, and warmup ratio 0.1. (Paper Eq. 4; Appendix B)
  1. Policy checkpoint selection. Save a checkpoint every 50 steps. On each prompt in D_MS, generate one response from a saved checkpoint and one from the policy at the start of the iteration. The current RM chooses the higher-scored response; average these comparisons into a win rate. Retain the checkpoint with the highest win rate. If the best checkpoint scores below tau=60%, stop and preserve the previous policy. The paper's four-iteration extension demonstrates this branch at iteration 4. (Paper Eq. 6–7; Appendix B, H)
  1. M-step policy-comparison records. For each reward-update prompt, generate y_t from the selected policy and y_{t-1} from its predecessor. Assign the provisional pair direction y_t preferred over y_{t-1}. Compute delta_r = r_{t-1}(y_t) - r_{t-1}(y_{t-1}) and set epsilon_t to the standard deviation of the previous-policy response scores over the reward-update data. The final Low-Quality Data Filtering strategy discards a pair when the updated response is confidently worse (delta_r <= -epsilon_t) and retains the rest, including margins between -epsilon_t and zero. (Paper Eq. 5, 8; Appendix F)
  1. Reward-model update and next iteration. Train a Bradley–Terry RM on mixed data: self-training preferences previously ranked by the RM plus the filtered updated-versus-previous policy comparisons. Each RM iteration starts again from the base RM to mitigate repeated-prompt overfitting, rather than continuing from the last RM checkpoint. Use one epoch, batch size 512, maximum sequence length 2,048, learning rate 2e-6, cosine scheduling, and 0.1 warmup. The updated RM then labels the next policy-update portion. The main setup uses two iterations and eight NVIDIA A100 GPUs. (Paper §5.1, §5.3; Appendix B)

The resulting training objects are DPO pairs, checkpoint-comparison outcomes, filtered policy-comparison pairs, RM scores, thresholds, policy/RM identities, and iteration links. A faithful implementation must version all of them, including discarded pairs. It must also fix the UltraFeedback revision, tokenizer and chat template, generation engine, FsfairX checkpoint, response-score convention, random seeds, D_MS membership, and evaluation harness versions. None of those record-level manifests or Mutual-Taught configs is available from the paper-linked repository: its only branch currently contains Alignment Handbook material, with no method-specific tags or releases.

The supervision granularity is pairwise preference plus scalar reward, not step-level process supervision. The training uses are preference learning and reward modeling. AlpacaEval-2, Arena-Hard, RewardBench, and the additional leaderboard tasks are evaluation surfaces only; they are not used as programmatic reward during the reported training.

报告流程可以在模块层面重建，但官方方法实现目前不可用。

  1. 输入与划分。 策略从 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 初始化，RM 从 FsfairX-Llama3-RM-v0.1 初始化；提示来自约 6 万条 UltraFeedback。论文把提示分成两个策略更新部分和一个 RM 更新部分，即三分之二用于策略更新、三分之一保留给 RM 更新。此外，还从 UltraFeedback 随机抽取固定 2000 条 D_MS 用于 checkpoint 选择。精确记录 ID 和集合间是否不相交均未知。（论文 §5.1；附录 B–C）
  1. E-step 候选生成与 pair 构造。 对每条策略更新提示，当前策略以温度 0.8、top-p 0.95 采样 M=5 个响应，当前 RM 对全部响应打分。为控制长度，先保留高于该提示平均奖励的响应，再选其中最短者作为 chosen，最低分响应作为 rejected。随后以迭代开始时的策略为参照，进行一个 epoch 的 DPO：beta 0.01、batch size 128、最大序列长度 2048、学习率 7e-7、cosine schedule、warmup ratio 0.1。（论文公式 4；附录 B）
  1. 策略 checkpoint 选择。 每 50 step 保存一次 checkpoint。在 D_MS 的每条提示上，分别由候选 checkpoint 与该迭代开始时的策略生成一个响应，再由当前 RM 选择高分响应，汇总为胜率。保留胜率最高的 checkpoint；若最高值低于 tau=60%，则终止并保留上一策略。论文的四迭代扩展在第 4 次迭代实际触发了这一分支。（论文公式 6–7；附录 B、H）
  1. M-step 策略比较记录。 对每条 RM 更新提示，由选中策略生成 y_t，上一策略生成 y_{t-1}，先暂定 y_t 优于 y_{t-1}。计算 delta_r = r_{t-1}(y_t) - r_{t-1}(y_{t-1})，并把上一策略响应在 RM 更新数据上的分数标准差设为 epsilon_t。最终采用的 Low-Quality Data Filtering 会在更新响应明显更差时丢弃 pair，即 delta_r <= -epsilon_t；其余全部保留，其中包括 -epsilon_t 到 0 之间的轻微负差值。（论文公式 5、8；附录 F）
  1. RM 更新与下一轮。 用混合数据训练 Bradley–Terry RM：一部分是先前由 RM 排序得到的 self-training 偏好，另一部分是筛选后的更新策略对上一策略比较。为减轻相同提示反复训练导致的过拟合，每次 RM 迭代都从基础 RM 重新开始，而不是沿用上一 RM checkpoint。设置为一个 epoch、batch size 512、最大序列长度 2048、学习率 2e-6、cosine schedule 与 0.1 warmup。更新后的 RM 再为下一份策略更新数据标注。主要设置执行两次迭代，使用 8 张 NVIDIA A100。（论文 §5.1、§5.3；附录 B）

最终训练对象包括 DPO pair、checkpoint 比较结果、筛选后的策略比较 pair、RM 分数、阈值、策略/RM 身份与迭代链路。忠实实现必须对这些对象全部做版本记录，包括被丢弃的 pair；还需固定 UltraFeedback 修订版、tokenizer 与 chat template、生成引擎、FsfairX checkpoint、响应分数约定、随机种子、D_MS 成员和评测 harness 版本。论文链接的仓库没有这些记录级 manifest 或 Mutual-Taught 配置：当前唯一分支包含 Alignment Handbook 内容，也没有方法专用 tag 或 release。

监督粒度是 pairwise preference 加 scalar reward，不是 step-level process supervision；训练用途限于 preference learning 与 reward modeling。AlpacaEval-2、Arena-Hard、RewardBench 及附加 leaderboard 任务只是评测面，不是报告训练中的程序化奖励。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest policy result is the controlled comparison in Table 1 under the paper's Llama-3-8B-Instruct and UltraFeedback setup. The base model scores 23.1% length-controlled (LC) win rate on AlpacaEval-2 and 20.6% win rate on Arena-Hard. Mutual-Taught Iter1 reports 38.4% and 33.9%; Iter2 reports 54.1% and 38.4%. The strongest displayed iterative DPO baseline after three iterations reports 47.2% LC on AlpacaEval-2 and 34.7% on Arena-Hard. Mutual-Taught uses only two thirds of the prompt portions for policy updates, whereas iterative baselines use all three portions and three iterations. AlpacaEval-2 uses GPT-4-Preview-1106 as baseline and judge; Arena-Hard uses GPT-4-0314 as baseline and GPT-4-Preview-1106 as judge. (Paper §5.1–5.2, Table 1; Appendix A)

Reward-model evidence is mixed rather than uniformly positive. On RewardBench, FsfairX-Llama3-RM-v0.1 scores 84.7 average and Mutual-Taught Iter1/Iter2 score 85.8/87.0; GPT-4o-2024-08-06 is listed at 86.7. The Reasoning component rises from 86.4 to 95.8 and 95.7, but Chat moves from 99.4 to 98.3/98.2, Chat-Hard from 65.1 to 63.9/66.3, and Safety from 87.8 to 85.1/87.8. For in-distribution evaluation, the two-iteration policy generates responses for 2,000 randomly sampled UltraFeedback test prompts and GPT-4-Preview-1106 judges pairwise RM choices; Figure 3 reports progressively better updated-RM comparisons, but this is another model-judged evaluation rather than a human pseudo-label audit. (Paper §5.2, Figure 3, Table 2)

The data-type ablation directly supports the mixed-data construction claim. The paper compares RM training on self-training data, policy-comparison data, and their mixture. Using self-training alone reduces downstream policy performance relative to the mixture by 6.3 points on AlpacaEval and 3.5 points on Arena-Hard; policy-comparison alone also underperforms the mixture, while the paper reports a smaller policy effect and some RM deterioration. Appendix F compares filtering strategies: the adopted Low-Quality Data Filtering is better on AlpacaEval-2, whereas High-Quality Data Selection and Direct Self-Training are slightly better on RewardBench. This is a task-dependent trade-off, not evidence that one filtering rule produces universally correct pairs. (Paper §5.3, Figure 4; Appendix F, Figure 7)

Two additional results define the generalization boundary. When the iterated RM guides one DPO iteration for Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 on UltraFeedback, AlpacaEval-2 LC rises from 42.0 with the base RM to 45.5 with Iter1 RM and 46.8 with Iter2 RM. However, the additional Open LLM Leaderboard table shows Mutual-Taught below the base model on GSM8K (70.67 versus 75.21) and MMLU (64.13 versus 65.71), while improving HellaSwag (81.37 versus 78.48) and TruthfulQA (55.21 versus 51.64); the average changes only from 67.76 to 67.85. These results do not establish broad reasoning improvement. (Paper Table 3; Appendix G, Table 4)

The extended-iteration experiment supplies an important negative result. Dividing the original 40,000 policy prompts into four portions produces AlpacaEval-2 LC scores of 34.7, 41.0, 44.9, and then 40.3. At iteration 4, the selected checkpoint's model-selection win rate is 57.7%, below tau=60%, so early stopping returns the iteration-3 policy. This shows the stabilization rule reacting to observed degradation; it does not prove that the RM-based validation criterion always detects true preference deterioration. (Appendix H, Table 5)

All numbers above are author-reported and were not independently reproduced for this Card. They support a policy/RM co-training recipe under the reported model, prompt source, judges, and budget. They do not measure human correctness of the generated preference pairs, retained-versus-discarded pair precision, RM calibration, contamination, or release quality. Artifact inspection further weakens reproducibility: the official paper prints a GitHub URL, but its only current branch is an Alignment Handbook snapshot with no Mutual-Taught-specific implementation, configs, data, checkpoints, tags, or releases.

最强的策略结果来自论文在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 与 UltraFeedback 设置下的表 1 对照。基础模型在 AlpacaEval-2 上的长度控制胜率为 23.1%，在 Arena-Hard 上的胜率为 20.6%；Mutual-Taught Iter1 分别报告 38.4% 和 33.9%，Iter2 为 54.1% 和 38.4%。表中最强的 iterative DPO 基线经过三次迭代后，AlpacaEval-2 长度控制胜率为 47.2%，Arena-Hard 为 34.7%。Mutual-Taught 只把三分之二提示划分用于策略更新，而迭代基线使用全部三份并运行三次。AlpacaEval-2 由 GPT-4-Preview-1106 同时充当基线与 judge；Arena-Hard 以 GPT-4-0314 为基线、GPT-4-Preview-1106 为 judge。（论文 §5.1–5.2、表 1；附录 A）

奖励模型证据并非各维度一致改善。RewardBench 上，FsfairX-Llama3-RM-v0.1 平均分为 84.7，Mutual-Taught Iter1/Iter2 为 85.8/87.0，表中 GPT-4o-2024-08-06 为 86.7。Reasoning 从 86.4 升至 95.8 和 95.7，但 Chat 从 99.4 变为 98.3/98.2，Chat-Hard 从 65.1 变为 63.9/66.3，Safety 从 87.8 变为 85.1/87.8。分布内评测中，两次迭代后的策略在随机抽取的 2000 条 UltraFeedback test 提示上生成响应，再由 GPT-4-Preview-1106 对 RM 的成对选择做判断；图 3 报告更新 RM 的相对结果逐步改善，但这仍是模型评审，不是人类伪标签审计。（论文 §5.2、图 3、表 2）

数据类型消融直接支持混合数据构造主张。论文比较仅用 self-training 数据、仅用 policy-comparison 数据以及两者混合训练 RM。仅使用 self-training 时，相对混合设置，后续策略在 AlpacaEval 与 Arena-Hard 上分别下降 6.3 和 3.5 个点；仅用 policy-comparison 也不如混合设置，论文报告其策略影响较小，但 RM 有所下降。附录 F 对比不同筛选方法：最终采用的 Low-Quality Data Filtering 在 AlpacaEval-2 上更好，而 High-Quality Data Selection 与 Direct Self-Training 在 RewardBench 上略好。这说明存在任务相关权衡，不能据此认定某个筛选规则会生成普遍正确的 pair。（论文 §5.3、图 4；附录 F、图 7）

另外两组结果界定了泛化边界。当迭代 RM 用于指导 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 在 UltraFeedback 上进行一次 DPO 时，AlpacaEval-2 长度控制胜率从基础 RM 的 42.0 提升到 Iter1 RM 的 45.5 和 Iter2 RM 的 46.8。但附加 Open LLM Leaderboard 表中，Mutual-Taught 在 GSM8K 上低于基础模型（70.67 对 75.21），在 MMLU 上也更低（64.13 对 65.71），同时 HellaSwag 从 78.48 升到 81.37，TruthfulQA 从 51.64 升到 55.21，平均值只从 67.76 变为 67.85。这些结果不足以证明广泛的推理能力提升。（论文表 3；附录 G、表 4）

扩展迭代实验提供了重要负结果。把原来的 4 万条策略提示分成四份后，AlpacaEval-2 长度控制胜率依次为 34.7、41.0、44.9，随后降到 40.3。第 4 次迭代中，选中 checkpoint 的模型选择胜率为 57.7%，低于 tau=60%，因此 early stopping 返回第 3 次迭代策略。这表明稳定规则对一次实际退化作出了反应，但不能证明 RM 验证标准总能识别真实偏好退化。（附录 H、表 5）

以上数值均为作者报告，本 Card 未独立复现。它们支持的是特定模型、提示来源、judge 与预算下的策略/RM 协同训练配方，而不是对生成偏好 pair 的人类正确率、保留/丢弃 pair 精度、RM 校准、污染或发布质量的测量。artifact 核查还显示复现边界：论文确实印有 GitHub 地址，但其当前唯一分支只是 Alignment Handbook 快照，没有 Mutual-Taught 专用实现、配置、数据、checkpoint、tag 或 release。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline is iterative preference optimization that refreshes policy-generated data while treating the feedback source as fixed. Iterative DPO updates the policy and reference checkpoint; SPPO and related self-play methods compare self-generated responses; ReSTEM also uses an EM/self-training interpretation to improve a policy. Human-refresh RLHF collects new current-policy responses and pays for new preference labels. Self-Rewarding and Meta-Rewarding fold generation and LLM-as-a-judge capability into one model. ReST-MCTS* constructs feedback from search plus task ground truth. (Paper §2)

Mutual-Taught changes the identity of the feedback model during the same loop. Its E-step is recognizable on-policy DPO: five current-policy candidates are scored by the current RM and compressed into a length-controlled pair. Its M-step introduces a second dynamic data object: a comparison between the selected updated policy and its predecessor, filtered by an iteration-specific RM-score dispersion threshold and mixed with self-training pairs before RM retraining. This makes the preference dataset an interface between two checkpoints rather than a fixed input to one optimizer.

The new feedback interface has three operational parts. First, checkpoint selection attempts to prevent policy degradation before pseudo-pairs are constructed. Second, Low-Quality Data Filtering removes updated-policy responses that the existing RM regards as confidently worse while retaining mildly negative examples as regularization. Third, the RM is reinitialized from the base checkpoint for each refresh, so policy-derived data changes the learned RM without simply continuing its previous optimizer trajectory. These choices define the construction recipe and should be preserved in comparisons.

Several components are inherited rather than novel: UltraFeedback supplies prompts; Llama-3-8B-Instruct and FsfairX-Llama3-RM-v0.1 supply initialization; DPO supplies the policy objective; Bradley–Terry supplies reward modeling; Alignment Handbook and RLHF-Reward-Modeling are named as training frameworks; SimPO motivates sampling settings; and model-based judges supply evaluation. The paper's contribution is their coupled update and stabilization schedule, not a new preference semantics, human-label source, reward architecture, benchmark, or released dataset.

The EM label should be interpreted narrowly. Appendix D gives monotonic-improvement and stationary-point statements under exact E/M optimization and unbiased pseudo-label estimation. The neural implementation uses approximate DPO/RM optimization and RM-derived labels whose unbiasedness is not established. Consequently, the theorem explains the intended analogy under assumptions; it does not independently validate the practical pseudo-pairs or make the current RM a ground-truth preference estimator.

For reasoning-data research, the direction signal is that feedback-model refresh itself creates and selects data. A reusable lineage record must therefore include both policies, the RM checkpoint, all candidates and scores, the selection set, the filter threshold, accepted and rejected pairs, and iteration identity. Before reuse, a builder must inspect pseudo-label error against independent human judgments, RM calibration and gaming, split isolation, versioned configurations, and the missing implementation. Without those checks, Mutual-Taught is a mechanism comparison and audit case, not a ready-made dynamic preference release.

既有工作基线是刷新策略生成数据、但把反馈来源保持固定的迭代偏好优化。Iterative DPO 更新策略与参照 checkpoint；SPPO 等 self-play 方法比较自行生成的响应；ReSTEM 也采用 EM/self-training 解释来改善策略。人类刷新式 RLHF 会收集当前策略新响应并支付新的偏好标注成本。Self-Rewarding 与 Meta-Rewarding 把生成和 LLM-as-a-judge 能力合并到同一模型。ReST-MCTS* 则从搜索与任务 ground truth 构造反馈。（论文 §2）

Mutual-Taught 真正改变的是同一闭环中的反馈模型身份。E-step 仍是可识别的 on-policy DPO：当前策略生成五个候选，由当前 RM 打分，再压缩为经长度控制的 pair。M-step 引入第二种动态数据对象：选中更新策略与其上一版本的比较，经过随迭代变化的 RM 分数离散阈值筛选，再与 self-training pair 混合后重训 RM。偏好数据因此成为两个 checkpoint 之间的接口，而不是单个优化器的固定输入。

这一新反馈接口有三个操作组件。第一，checkpoint 选择试图在构造伪 pair 前防止策略退化。第二，Low-Quality Data Filtering 会删除被现有 RM 判断为明显更差的更新策略响应，同时保留轻微负向样本作为正则。第三，每次刷新都从基础 checkpoint 重新初始化 RM，使策略衍生数据改变所学 RM，而不是简单延续上一 RM 的优化轨迹。这些选择共同定义构造配方，做对照实验时应完整保留。

多个组件来自既有工作而非本文新创：UltraFeedback 提供提示，Llama-3-8B-Instruct 与 FsfairX-Llama3-RM-v0.1 提供初始化，DPO 提供策略目标，Bradley–Terry 提供奖励建模，论文指定 Alignment Handbook 与 RLHF-Reward-Modeling 为训练框架，采样设置沿用 SimPO，评测依赖模型 judge。本文贡献是这些组件的耦合更新与稳定日程，不是新的偏好语义、人类标签来源、奖励架构、benchmark 或公开数据集。

“EM”标签应作窄义理解。附录 D 在 E/M 步精确优化且伪标签估计无偏的前提下，给出单调改进与驻点结论；实际神经网络实现采用近似 DPO/RM 优化，RM 衍生标签的无偏性也未建立。因此，该定理解释的是有条件的方法类比，不能独立验证实际伪 pair，也不能把当前 RM 升格为真实偏好估计器。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，方向意义在于：反馈模型刷新本身就在生成并筛选数据。可复用谱系记录必须同时保存两个策略、RM checkpoint、全部候选及分数、选择集、筛选阈值、接受与拒绝 pair 和迭代身份。复用前还需用独立人类判断检查伪标签错误、RM 校准与 gaming、split 隔离、版本化配置和缺失实现。缺少这些检查时，Mutual-Taught 只能作为机制对照和审计案例，而不是可直接使用的动态偏好发布。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The authors explicitly note two modeling limits: complex logical reasoning and long dependencies may converge slowly, and unrestricted iteration may over-optimize. Appendix H confirms an observed boundary rather than only a hypothetical one: iteration 4 lowers AlpacaEval-2 LC from 44.9 to 40.3 before the 60% model-selection threshold returns the prior policy. The threshold is tuned to stay above chance while allowing continued updates; its transfer to other policies, judges, or domains is not established. (Paper Limitations; Appendix H)

The central label assumption is self-referential. The updated response is marked preferred because the policy was optimized against the current RM, not because a human or task oracle compared the two responses. That same RM ranks the five E-step candidates, chooses the policy checkpoint on D_MS, computes the M-step margin, and supplies the uncertainty scale used for filtering. A blind spot or exploitable style preference can therefore affect every gate. This creates false-positive pseudo-pairs when high RM score does not reflect human preference and false negatives when useful policy changes score below the threshold. Reward hacking, shared drift, and confirmation bias are curator-inferred risks supported by the dependency graph, not measured failure rates.

Low-Quality Data Filtering is deliberately permissive. It discards only pairs with delta_r <= -epsilon_t; pairs whose updated response scores slightly below the preceding response remain as regularization. Their true label-noise rate is unknown, and Appendix F shows that alternative filtering rules trade AlpacaEval-2 policy performance against RewardBench RM performance. The variance threshold measures dispersion of current-RM scores, not calibrated probability that a pair direction is correct. Length control introduces another shortcut channel because chosen responses are the shortest among above-average-scoring candidates.

The theoretical guarantee has stronger premises than the experiment verifies. Appendix D assumes exact optimization in both steps and unbiased pseudo-label estimation, then argues monotonic expected-reward improvement. No independent evidence establishes either premise for DPO, neural RM fitting, or updated-versus-previous pseudo-labels. RM-based checkpoint selection can guarantee improvement only under the RM criterion being measured; it cannot by itself establish improvement under latent human preference.

Data and release auditability are incomplete. The paper does not disclose immutable UltraFeedback record IDs, exact subset counts, whether the 2,000 selection prompts are disjoint, decontamination, generated-token totals, seeds and variance for the main tables, accepted/discarded pair counts, pseudo-label accuracy, reward calibration, or full run logs. No dynamic pair stream or failed samples are released. The paper-linked GitHub repository declares Apache-2.0 but currently contains Alignment Handbook material rather than Mutual-Taught code, configs, data, or checkpoints; that license cannot be treated as a license for absent method artifacts or upstream data.

Evaluation also has a circular or proxy character. GPT-4-Preview-1106 judges AlpacaEval-2 and the in-distribution RM comparison; RewardBench evaluates agreement with benchmark preferences. These are useful external surfaces, but neither directly audits the training pair labels. The main instruction-following gains coexist with drops on GSM8K and MMLU and with non-monotonic RewardBench subcategories. Benchmark performance therefore supports a conditional training-recipe result, not a claim that the constructed data is high quality, unbiased, uncontaminated, or broadly transferable.

作者明确指出两项建模限制：复杂逻辑推理和长依赖任务可能收敛缓慢，无限制迭代可能导致过优化。附录 H 给出的不是纯假设，而是一个实际边界：第 4 次迭代让 AlpacaEval-2 长度控制胜率从 44.9 降到 40.3，随后 60% 模型选择阈值返回上一策略。该阈值被设为高于随机水平、同时允许继续更新，但它能否迁移到其他策略、judge 或领域并未建立。（论文 Limitations；附录 H）

核心标签假设具有自指性。更新响应之所以被标为 preferred，是因为策略针对当前 RM 做过优化，而不是人类或任务 oracle 比较了两个响应。随后，同一个 RM 又负责排序五个 E-step 候选、在 D_MS 上选择策略 checkpoint、计算 M-step 分数差，并提供筛选所用的不确定性尺度。因此，一个盲点或可利用的风格偏好可能影响所有门控。当高 RM 分数不代表人类偏好时会产生伪 pair false positive；有价值的策略变化被阈值压低时会产生 false negative。reward hacking、共享漂移和确认偏差是由依赖关系推导出的 curator inference，并非论文测得的失效率。

Low-Quality Data Filtering 有意保持宽松。它只丢弃 delta_r <= -epsilon_t 的 pair；若更新响应只比上一响应略低，仍会作为正则保留。其真实标签噪声率未知，附录 F 还显示不同筛选规则会在 AlpacaEval-2 策略表现与 RewardBench RM 表现之间产生权衡。方差阈值测量的是当前 RM 分数离散度，不是 pair 方向正确概率的校准值。长度控制也引入了额外捷径通道，因为 chosen 响应是高于平均分候选中最短的一个。

理论保证的前提比实验所验证的更强。附录 D 假设两个步骤都精确优化，且伪标签估计无偏，随后推导期望奖励单调改善。论文没有独立证据说明 DPO、神经 RM 拟合或更新策略对上一策略伪标签满足这些前提。基于 RM 的 checkpoint 选择只能保证被测 RM 标准上的改善，不能单独证明潜在人类偏好上的改善。

数据与发布可审计性不完整。论文没有披露不可变的 UltraFeedback 记录 ID、精确子集数量、2000 条选择提示是否不相交、去污染、生成 token 总量、主表随机种子与方差、接受/丢弃 pair 数量、伪标签准确率、奖励校准或完整运行日志，也没有发布动态 pair 流或失败样本。论文链接的 GitHub 仓库虽然声明 Apache-2.0，但当前内容是 Alignment Handbook，而非 Mutual-Taught 代码、配置、数据或 checkpoint；该许可证不能替代缺失方法 artifact 或上游数据的许可。

评测也存在循环性或代理性。GPT-4-Preview-1106 负责 AlpacaEval-2 与分布内 RM 比较，RewardBench 测量与 benchmark 偏好的符合程度。这些是有用外部评测面，但都不直接审计训练 pair 标签。主要指令跟随提升同时伴随 GSM8K、MMLU 下降以及 RewardBench 子类别非单调变化。因此，benchmark 表现只能支持有条件的训练配方结果，不能证明所构造数据高质量、无偏、无污染或广泛可迁移。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the data_construction_open_release_recipes track, Mutual-Taught is most useful as a specification for dynamic preference lineage. It shows that a preference record may be valid only relative to an iteration, a policy pair, and the RM that scored it. A downstream schema should preserve the prompt; current and previous policy IDs; all sampled candidates; chosen/rejected construction; current-RM ID and scores; checkpoint-selection result; reward margin and standard deviation; filter decision; self-training versus policy-comparison origin; and policy/RM training step. Without these fields, the claimed co-adaptation cannot be replayed or audited.

Concrete research uses include:

  • implementing an RM-refresh baseline that alternates on-policy DPO and Bradley–Terry reward training;
  • comparing mixed self-training/policy-comparison data with either source alone at matched prompt and generation budgets;
  • replacing the circular RM gate with human labels, rule verifiers, a held-out judge, or calibrated model ensembles to measure pseudo-label error;
  • testing LQF, HQS, and DST while reporting both policy outcomes and RM calibration rather than one benchmark score;
  • auditing checkpoint selection and early stopping with independent preferences instead of the RM that trained the policy;
  • studying how refresh cadence, base-RM reinitialization, length control, and prompt reuse affect drift and catastrophic forgetting.

A safe replication should first create an immutable prompt split with a separately held-out D_MS, pin Llama/FsfairX model revisions and tokenizer/chat-template versions, log all random seeds and generated-token counts, and retain both accepted and rejected pairs. It should report pair yield by margin bin, human preference accuracy, RM calibration, reward-score inflation, response length, judge disagreement, and downstream task quality. Frozen-RM iterative DPO, newly human-labeled RM refresh, and a rule-anchored refresh should be included as controls; otherwise co-adaptation cannot be separated from extra generation, checkpoint selection, or judge-specific optimization.

The practical reuse class is reading/audit reference only; executable training reuse is blocked pending artifact verification. The ACL paper is sufficient to reconstruct the intended modules and settings, and its negative iteration result is useful for designing stopping audits. It is not sufficient to reproduce the exact run or reuse a released dataset: the official paper-linked repository contains no verified Mutual-Taught-specific implementation or immutable release, and the dynamic training records, checkpoints, split manifest, pseudo-label audit, and licenses are missing.

The paper should not be repurposed as evidence that synthetic preferences replace humans in general, that RM scores are calibrated correctness probabilities, or that a higher AlpacaEval/RewardBench score proves better data. Its strongest Atlas use is a controlled case for asking what must be logged when a policy and its feedback model jointly define the next training distribution.

对于 data_construction_open_release_recipes 赛道，Mutual-Taught 最有价值的用途是定义动态偏好谱系。它表明，一条偏好记录可能只在特定迭代、策略 pair 与打分 RM 的条件下成立。下游 schema 应保存提示、当前与上一策略 ID、全部采样候选、chosen/rejected 构造、当前 RM ID 与分数、checkpoint 选择结果、奖励差与标准差、筛选决策、self-training 或 policy-comparison 来源，以及策略/RM 训练步骤。缺少这些字段，就无法重放或审计论文所称的协同适配。

具体研究用途包括：

  • 实现交替执行 on-policy DPO 与 Bradley–Terry 奖励训练的 RM 刷新基线；
  • 在提示量和生成预算匹配时，对比混合 self-training/policy-comparison 数据与单独使用任一来源；
  • 用人类标签、规则 verifier、留出 judge 或校准模型集成替代循环 RM 门控，以测量伪标签错误；
  • 比较 LQF、HQS 与 DST，同时报告策略结果与 RM 校准，而不是只报单个 benchmark 分数；
  • 用独立偏好审计 checkpoint 选择和 early stopping，不再依赖训练策略的同一个 RM；
  • 研究刷新频率、基础 RM 重初始化、长度控制和提示复用如何影响漂移与灾难性遗忘。

安全复现应先建立不可变提示划分和独立留出的 D_MS，固定 Llama/FsfairX 模型修订版及 tokenizer/chat-template 版本，记录全部随机种子和生成 token 数，并同时保存接受与拒绝 pair。报告应包含各分数差区间的 pair 产率、人类偏好准确率、RM 校准、奖励分数膨胀、响应长度、judge 分歧和下游任务质量。还应加入冻结 RM 的 iterative DPO、新增人类标注的 RM 刷新、规则锚定刷新作为对照；否则无法把协同适配与额外生成、checkpoint 选择或针对特定 judge 的优化分离。

实际复用等级是：仅适合作为阅读/审计参考；可执行训练复用在 artifact 核验前受阻。ACL 论文足以重建预期模块与设置，其迭代退化负结果也有助于设计停止审计；但它不足以精确复现运行或复用公开数据集。论文链接的官方仓库没有可验证的 Mutual-Taught 专用实现或不可变 release，动态训练记录、checkpoint、split manifest、伪标签审计和许可证也都缺失。

不应把这篇论文改写成“合成偏好普遍可以替代人类”“RM 分数就是校准后的正确率”，或“AlpacaEval/RewardBench 更高就证明数据更好”。它在 Atlas 中最强的用途，是作为一个受控案例，追问策略与反馈模型共同定义下一轮训练分布时必须记录哪些信息。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Data identity: distinguish the E-step's five-candidate RM-ranked DPO pair from the M-step's updated-versus-previous policy pseudo-pair; the main RM update mixes policy-comparison and self-training records.
  • Feedback dependency: the current RM ranks candidates, selects checkpoints, computes margins, and filters the data used to refresh itself; no independent human or task oracle validates those gates.
  • Settings to retain: UltraFeedback three-way allocation, fixed 2,000-prompt selection set, M=5, temperature 0.8, top-p 0.95, DPO beta 0.01, 50-step checkpoints, tau=60%, LQF, and base-RM reinitialization.
  • Evidence boundary: Table 1 reports 54.1% AlpacaEval-2 LC and 38.4% Arena-Hard at Iter2, but GSM8K/MMLU decline and iteration 4 degrades before early stopping; benchmark gains are not a pseudo-label-quality audit.
  • Release boundary: the ACL/DOI/arXiv records and affiliations are verified, but the paper-linked GitHub default branch is an Alignment Handbook snapshot with no Mutual-Taught-specific code, configs, data, models, tags, or releases.

• 数据身份： 区分 E-step 中由 RM 排序五个候选得到的 DPO pair，与 M-step 中更新策略对上一策略的伪 pair；主要 RM 更新会混合 policy-comparison 与 self-training 记录。
  • 反馈依赖： 当前 RM 同时负责候选排序、checkpoint 选择、分数差计算与刷新自身所用数据的筛选；这些门控没有独立人类或任务 oracle 验证。
  • 必须保留的设置： UltraFeedback 三路划分、固定 2000 条选择集、M=5、温度 0.8、top-p 0.95、DPO beta 0.01、每 50 step 保存 checkpoint、tau=60%、LQF 和基础 RM 重初始化。
  • 证据边界： 表 1 的 Iter2 报告 AlpacaEval-2 长度控制胜率 54.1%、Arena-Hard 胜率 38.4%，但 GSM8K/MMLU 下降，第 4 次迭代也在 early stopping 前退化；benchmark 提升不是伪标签质量审计。
  • 发布边界： ACL/DOI/arXiv 记录与机构已核验，但论文链接的 GitHub 默认分支只是 Alignment Handbook 快照，没有 Mutual-Taught 专用代码、配置、数据、模型、tag 或 release。

value.html: Approximately 60,000 UltraFeedback prompts are divided across two policy-update subsets and a reward-model-update subset; a fixed 2,000-prompt UltraFeedback set is used for checkpoint selection.

The E-step stores an RM-ranked chosen/rejected response pair for each prompt; the M-step stores a prompt with one response from the updated policy and one from the previous policy, provisionally ordered as updated-over-previous.
The current Llama-3-8B-Instruct policy samples candidates for E-step preference construction; the selected updated policy and its predecessor generate the paired responses used in the M-step.
EM-inspired alternating on-policy DPO and Bradley-Terry reward-model training over UltraFeedback prompts.
The current FsfairX-Llama3-RM-v0.1-derived reward model ranks E-step candidates, selects policy checkpoints, computes the M-step margin, and therefore supplies every training preference in the loop.

Within an iteration, retain the checkpoint with the highest current-RM win rate against the preceding policy on the fixed selection set; stop if that maximum is below tau=60%. The principal experiment reports two iterations.
Llama-3-8B-Instruct policy and FsfairX-Llama3-RM-v0.1 reward model.
No new human annotator; the current reward model supplies E-step rankings and the updated-over-previous policy assumption supplies the initial M-step pseudo-label direction.
The current policy samples E-step candidates; the selected updated and preceding policy checkpoints each generate an M-step response for the same reward-update prompt.

Sample M=5 responses per prompt at temperature 0.8 and top-p 0.95; choose the shortest above-average-reward response and the lowest-reward response; run DPO; select among checkpoints saved every 50 steps; construct and filter updated-versus-previous policy pairs; update the reward model; repeat.

The reported Low-Quality Data Filtering rule discards a policy-comparison pair when the updated response scores at least one current-score standard deviation below the previous response; it retains all other pairs, including mildly negative margins. The reward model is trained on mixed self-training and policy-comparison data.
Two reported iterations, one epoch per policy and reward-model update, 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs, maximum sequence length 2,048; the complete wall-clock and generated-token budget is unknown.

DPO uses beta 0.01, batch size 128, learning rate 7e-7, cosine scheduling, and 0.1 warmup; reward modeling uses Bradley-Terry loss, batch size 512, learning rate 2e-6, and reinitializes each reward-model iteration from the base RM.
UltraFeedback prompts plus preferences inherited from FsfairX-Llama3-RM-v0.1; on-policy candidates, self-training pairs, and pre/post-policy comparison pairs are produced during the loop.

The paper divides approximately 60,000 UltraFeedback prompts into three subsets and reserves one third for reward-model updates; it also samples a fixed 2,000-prompt UltraFeedback model-selection set. Record IDs, exact counts, and whether the selection set is disjoint from training are not disclosed as a manifest.
unknown

items: The same current reward model ranks policy candidates, selects checkpoints, and filters the pseudo-pairs used to retrain itself, so shared error and reward hacking can circulate through the loop.

Treating an updated-policy response as preferred is not an independent ground-truth label; Low-Quality Data Filtering removes only confidently negative margins and intentionally retains mildly negative pairs.
The monotonic-improvement theorem assumes exact E/M optimization and unbiased pseudo-label estimates, neither of which is established for the neural training run.
GPT-4-Preview-1106 supplies policy evaluation judgments, and RewardBench scores reward-model agreement; these outcomes do not audit pseudo-label correctness or preference-data quality.
The fourth-iteration extension degrades AlpacaEval-2 LC win rate from 44.9 to 40.3 before the 60% early-stop rule selects the previous checkpoint, showing an observed over-optimization boundary.

No Mutual-Taught-specific implementation, configuration, data, checkpoint, dynamic pair stream, rejected-pair log, seed report, or immutable release was verified in the official paper-linked repository.
